changelog:
### Infrared Music v1.6.0 (Major Release)

#### Audio Pipeline & Playback Engine
• Playback: Self-healing background service (START_STICKY), CBR seek optimization, gapless queue wrapping, and Android Auto support.
• Multi-Provider Search: Seamless query and stream resolution across YouTube and Spotify (SoundCloud support will be added later)

#### Visualizer & Aesthetics
• Audio Reactor Overhaul: Upgraded to Spectral Flux Onset Detection and Adaptive Variance Thresholding for kick/drop synchronization. It's not the best but I'm working on it.
• Discrete Ripple System: Expanded object pool to 24 concurrent kinetic ripples with asymmetric attack/decay physics.
• Obsidian Oscilloscope: Added real-time dual-phase waveform rendering mode.
• Dynamic UI Glow: Added 4-quadrant artwork color extraction and neon ambient card highlights.

#### Web Uplink & Ecosystem
• YouTube Music-Styled Web Client: Direct in-browser streaming over local Wi-Fi, responsive dark UI, and playlist browsing.
• Discord Rich Presence: Real-time track metadata and artwork telemetry via local IPC companion daemon. (The python file will be uploaded for this feature soon in the github repo.)

#### Library, Metadata & Persistence
• On-Device Tag Editor: Native ID3/metadata tagging for MP3, M4A, and FLAC containers via jaudiotagger.
• Synced Lyrics: Added ObsidianLyricsView with LRC time-sync parsing and persistent unlock storage.
• Room DB Migrations: Persistent playback history matrix, Void Stats tracking, and backup/restore pipelines; all in your own phone, nothing cloud based.

#### Utilities
• Prayer Time Interceptor: Automated location-aware playback pausing.
• Jetpack Glance Widget: A better home page.
